payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 1 says each lens prompt 'lists the task's own in-cell finding,' and this test seeds exactly that (`ledger.record_findings(task_id, [Finding(..., claim="pre-existing")])` at line 293-304) to exercise it, but never checks that 'pre-existing' (or any trace of the known block) reaches either system prompt. Changing `saffron/commit_review.py`'s `known=end_review._known_block(ledger.findings(task_id))` to `known=""` leaves this test, and every other witness in the file, green, so the gate's `criteria: pass` for this criterion does not establish that the known-findings clause actually holds.
